title: olearia alpina
intro: Olearia alpina, commonly known as Alpine Daisy Bush or Alpine Tree Daisy, is a flowering plant species native to New Zealand. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Olearia alpina are attributed to its ability to relax the muscles, calm the nervous system, and exhibit antioxidant properties. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
